Control.name: Control
Control.definition: Identifies the key management scheme and associated control field format.|ISO 13492|Binary, length of 1

KeySetIdentifier.name: Key Set Identifier
KeySetIdentifier.definition: key-set identifier is a number that uniquely identifies a group of related keys that are all different but have certain characteristics in common.|ISO 13492||lengths of 6 or 8

DerivedInformation.name: Derived Information
DerivedInformation.definition: Contains Derived Info or Device ID and Transaction Counter.|ISO 13492||Binary, lengths of 5, 8, 16 or 32

Algorithm.name: Algorithm
Algorithm.definition: Used to select the encryption algorithm to encipher the keys contained in the associated key management data element. |ISO 13492

KeyLength.name: Key Length
KeyLength.definition: Specifies the length of the keys being transported, not the encrypting key.|ISO 13492

KeyProtection.name: Key Protection
KeyProtection.definition: Mechanism used to provide key confidentiality and integrity. |ISO 13492

KeyIndex.name: Key Index
KeyIndex.definition: Identifies a unique key set when multiple keys with the same key set identifier are used (for example, key rotation).||ISO 13492||Length of 2 or 5

EncryptedPINBlock.name: Encrypted PIN Block
EncryptedPINBlock.definition: As defined in ISO 9564-1. ||Binary, length of 8 or 16
